> **Code-level feature requests belong on a module repo, not here.** If you want a new feature in `townlight_records` or `townlight_core`, please file there.
>
> This umbrella accepts: new module proposals, roadmap reordering, governance/process changes, suite-wide naming or versioning conventions, and changes to the compatibility matrix policy.

## What category is this?

- [ ] New module proposal
- [ ] Roadmap reordering / re-prioritization
- [ ] Governance / contribution process change
- [ ] Suite-wide convention (naming, versioning, licensing posture, doc artifact)
- [ ] Compatibility matrix policy
- [ ] Other (describe)

## Problem

What problem does this solve? Who has the problem? (Be specific — "cities" is not specific; "small-town clerks who do agendas in Word" is.)

## Proposed change

What should change? Describe the end state, not the implementation.

## Alternatives considered

Other ways this could be solved, and why the proposed approach is preferred.

## Impact on existing modules

Does this affect any shipping or in-progress module? If so, which?

## Checklist

- [ ] I've confirmed this is suite-wide, not module-specific
- [ ] I've checked existing issues and Discussions for duplicates
- [ ] I've read the [Charter](CHARTER.md) (or am willing to read it before this is triaged)
